originalTitle: 40C3 halfnarp – Submit talk preferences to aid scheduling
content:
Help us to reduce conflicts of scheduling 40C3's Fahrplan: Click on the talks you would like to watch and press submit.

For questions please read our FAQ and our blogpost for details. Please report problems to erdgeist@ccc.de .

Select an event below to display halfnarp correlations, the darker the stronger.
